questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答 设全弧的质心坐标为}(\overline{x},\overline{y})，\text{显然} \overline{y}=0。\\ \overline{x}=\frac{\int_0^{\pi} \rho_0 xds}{M}=\frac{\int_0^{\pi} \rho_0 ds}{\int_0^{\pi} \rho_0 ds}=\frac{\int_0^{2\pi} a(1+\cos \theta)\cos \theta \sqrt{[a(1+\cos \theta)]^2+[a(1+\cos \theta)]'^2}d\theta}{\int_0^{2\pi} \sqrt{[a(1+\cos \theta)]^2+[a(1+\cos \theta)]'^2}d\theta}\\ =\frac{2a^2 \int_0^{2\pi}(1+\cos \theta)\cos \theta \left|\cos \frac{\theta}{2}\right| d\theta}{2a \int_0^{2\pi} \left|\cos \frac{\theta}{2}\right| d\theta}=\frac{2a^2 \int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(1+\cos \theta)\cos \theta \cos \frac{\theta}{2}d\theta}{8a}\\ =\frac{a}{4} \int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(1+\cos \theta)\cos \theta \cos \frac{\theta}{2}d\theta=\frac{a}{2} \int_0^{\pi}(1+\cos \theta)\cos \theta \cos \frac{\theta}{2}d\theta=\frac{a}{2} \int_0^{\pi} 2 \cos^2 \frac{\theta}{2} \cdot (2 \cos^2 \frac{\theta}{2}-1) \cdot \cos \frac{\theta}{2}d\theta\\ =2a \cdot \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(2 \cos^5 t-\cos^3 t)dt=2a(2 \cdot \frac{4}{5} \cdot \frac{2}{3} - \frac{2}{3})=\frac{4}{5}a\\ \text{所以全弧的质心坐标为} \left(\frac{4}{5},a,0\right)。\\ \text{所以全弧质心的直角坐标为}(\frac{4}{5},a,0)，\text{全弧质心对应的极坐标为}(\frac{4}{5},a,0)。 \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答 设此球面三角块的质量为}M, \text{则} \quad& M=\iint\limits_{S}\rho dS=\iint\limits_{S}(x^{2}+z^{2})dS.\text{根据被积函数的表达式,将}S\text{向}xoz\text{坐标面上投影。由}y=\sqrt{1-x^{2}-z^{2}}, \text{得}dS=\sqrt{1+y_{x}^{\prime 2}+y_{z}^{\prime 2}}dxdz=\frac{dxdz}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}-z^{2}}}, \text{从而} \\ M&=\iint\limits_{\Omega_{x}}\frac{x^{2}+z^{2}}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}-z^{2}}}dxdz=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{\rho^{2}}{\sqrt{1-\rho^{2}}}\rho d\rho d\rho=\frac{\pi}{4}\int_{0}^{1}\frac{\rho^{3}}{\sqrt{1-\rho^{2}}}d\rho\\ &\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{1-\rho^{2}}=u\\ &=-\frac{\pi}{4}\int_{1}^{0}\frac{u(1-u^{2})}{u}du=\frac{\pi}{4}\int_{0}^{1}(1-u^{2})du=\frac{\pi}{6}。 \end{aligned}
